relevance_note: Cohort study of 60 young female patients with advanced heart failure that describes seven female Danon disease patients individually (Tables 2 and 3: 'LAMP2 molecular genetic analyses, and LAMP2 myocardial expression in Danon disease female patients') plus three relatives carrying LAMP2 variants.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown including the supplementary docx. A Python script in my scratch directory assembled the JSON; every value was entered by hand from my reading, and the script only located each span verbatim in the paper (tolerating non-breaking spaces and U+2010 hyphens) and filled the 20 checklist rows per person. Scope: 7 female DD patients (#1-#7, Tables 2-3) labelled 'Patient #n'; relatives with LAMP2 variants: daughter of #5 (III.3, family CZ6), mother of #6 (II.2, obligatory heterozygote, CZ4) and older brother of #6 (labelled III.1 in the supplement's 'gave birth to a son - III.1' and III/1 elsewhere). The other 53 cohort patients are out of scope (cohort_size 60). Relatives of #3, #4 and #7 ('the only affected individuals in their families') have no individual detail and get no rows. Patients #1-#4 were reported before (Table 2 'Note' column, copied to source_reference_in_review); the family labels in those notes ('family 2', 'family 1') belong to the earlier paper and were not used as family_label_in_paper. Table 1 is group-level (counts and medians) and was not used for individuals; e.g. atrial fibrillation 3 (43%) of DD patients is not attributed. Heart failure was not marked for #1-#7: AHF is the study inclusion criterion and is not stated per person; heart transplantation ages are recorded as treatment only. Table 3 numeric echo/ECG values (QRS, LVEDD, LVEF, IVS, PW) were kept as detail on the DCM/HCM rows, not turned into features (e.g. LVEF 20% in HCM patients #3 and #5 not marked as reduced EF). HCM was mapped to the LVH checklist item and DCM to the dilated LV item. Table 3 'Absent' under Delta waves was taken as explicit absence (a word, not a symbol). Patient #2's HTx cell '—' is undefined, so not reported. Variants: #4 has one Xq24 deletion spanning CUL4B (partial), LAMP2, ATP1B4, TMEM255A and ZBTB33, recorded as one LAMP2 row. Protein strings are copied with the converter's '^*' artefact. The daughter's variant string comes from 'Patient #5 transmitted the LAMP2 mutation' plus #5's cDNA; her zygosity and type are left not reported. Inheritance 'inherited maternal' for #6 and the brother rests on the paper calling the mother an 'obligatory heterozygote' (not tested). A 4.9 kb mtDNA deletion (low heteroplasmy, skeletal muscle) in the brother and 'the same deletion' in #6 are recorded as gene 'mtDNA' rows. No stacked supplementary-table cells were used (the SOP table is not patient data). No internal contradictions found, except that #6's age at DD diagnosis (25) is lower than her age at HTx (27), which is not a contradiction as such.
